messages:
Marina (ops): starting war room — multiple customers reporting 503s / timeouts hitting hosted inference gateway since 02:10 UTC. Tickets: #ACME, #Zephyr. Can folks jump in?
Irene (support): seeing 12+ tickets escalated in the last 8 minutes, ~30% of requests returning 502/503 per customer logs. Customer repro attached in ticket.
Sam (frontend): confirmed spike on /v1/generate GET/POST at edge, p95 latency up, some streams dropping. Noticed increased 502s from apigw logs: upstream reset.
incident-bot: alert — gateway_503_rate > threshold in eu-west-1 (02:09:40 UTC).
Leo (runtime): pulling runtime traces now. Quick question — are we serving mixed quantized and fp16 variants on that route?
Marina (ops): yes route is using model: redwood/gpt-small:quant-v1 and fallback to gpt-small:fp16. Could be fallback thrash.
Nate (SRE): checking autoscaler and pool metrics — GPU pool for hosted-dedicated-eu shows sudden connection backlog and queued requests. Instance counts steady, no scale-up triggered yet. Will force scale up if needed.
Irene (support): customer repro steps: curl to /v1/generate with small prompt, sometimes returns 503, sometimes long hang then timeout. Repro snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16}'
```
Sam (frontend): can confirm gateway logs show `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `read timeout` from runtime side around 02:10-02:14.
Leo (runtime): grabbing runtime logs: kv-cache pressure jumped, many cache miss evictions. K/V client errors show `504` to disk-backed cache. Possible I/O spike.
Marina (ops): immediate mitigation options: 1) flip route to pinned fp16 model (no kv-cache) 2) temporarily increase gateway timeout and fallback cadence 3) open capacity (Nate). Which to take now?
Nate (SRE): I'm spinning up 3 extra backend replicas in eu-west now — should help throughput, ETA ~2m. Also enabling circuit-breaker for heavy clients to fail fast.
Irene (support): communicating to customers: "We are actively mitigating a hosted inference issue causing 503s for some requests in eu-west. Engineers are on it; we'll follow up in 30m."
Sam (frontend): quick change: route pinned to model variant `gpt-small:fp16` for affected endpoint. Pushing canary in 30s.
Leo (runtime): canary looks stable so far for small traffic. KV errors drop on pinned nodes. If canary holds, promote.
incident-bot: deploy started by Sam (frontend) — canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%
Marina (ops): promoting to 100%. Observability: 503 rate falling to baseline in next 90s. Please capture timeline for postmortem.
Nate (SRE): scaling finished, new pods healthy. No OOMs or CPU spikes on runtime, I/O latencies reduced after promoting pinned variant.
Irene (support): updating customer comms: "Issue mitigated — we pinned model variant and added capacity; customers may see transient errors for a short period. Postmortem to follow." :thumbsup:
Sam (frontend): rollback plan prepared if anything regresses.
Leo (runtime): initial hypothesis: kv-cache backend experienced brief I/O saturation in eu-west (backup store), causing cache misses and cascading backpressure to runtime, leading to upstream resets at gateway. Pinning off cache reduced pressure.
Marina (ops): action items (owners): 1) Leo — investigate kv-backend I/O metrics and engineer safeguards (rate-limiter/backpressure) — due EOD. 2) Nate — autoscaler tuning for faster vertical scaling and pre-warms for heavy-fanout routes — due 48h. 3) Sam — add route-level safety: prefer local-memory cache fallback and reduce aggressive fallback churn — due 72h. 4) Irene — draft initial postmortem for customers and support FAQ — due 24h.
Irene (support): taking postmortem draft, will include customer repro, mitigation timeline, and committed action items; sharing in #postmortems when ready.
Marina (ops): tagging follow-ups for PM/Infra review. We'll close war room; keep thread updated if anything reappears.
Nate (SRE): one more note — add alert to detect kv-cache backend I/O saturation before it impacts runtime (new alarm).
Leo (runtime): will run a repro harness hitting kv-backend with synthetic load to replicate. If reproducible, add circuit-breaker at runtime layer to fail to fallback early.
Marina (ops): thanks team — great coordination. Ending war room at 02:29 UTC.
Irene (support): marking tickets with mitigation notes and ETA for postmortem.
Marina (ops): last: collecting logs and traces for postmortem bundle — uploading to shared drive.`
